briefdescription.para: Adds a scalar to each initialized element of a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: This overload enables scalar + matrix syntax by forwarding the operation to the existing matrix + scalar member operator. Only initialized elements are updated in the result; uninitialized elements remain uninitialized.

parameterdescription.para: The type of the matrix elements.
The DenseMatrix to which the scalar is added.

simplesect.para: A new DenseMatrix<T> with scalar + matrix(i,j) for each initialized element.

briefdescription.para: Subtracts each element of a matrix from a scalar.

detaileddescription.para: This function computes the difference between a scalar and each initialized element in the given matrix. Only initialized elements contribute to the result; uninitialized elements remain uninitialized in the result.

parameterdescription.para: The element type of the matrix.
The scalar value to subtract from.
The matrix whose values will be subtracted from the scalar.

simplesect.para: A new DenseMatrix<T> where each initialized element is scalar - matrix(i,j)

detaileddescription.para: Output: * 9 8 * 7 6 *

briefdescription.para: Multiplies each element of a matrix by a scalar.

detaileddescription.para: Performs element-wise multiplication between a scalar and all initialized values of the matrix. This overload allows scalar * matrix in addition to matrix * scalar.

parameterdescription.para: The type of the matrix elements.
The matrix whose values will be multiplied.

simplesect.para: A new DenseMatrix<T> with each element equal to scalar * matrix(i,j)

memberdef.argsstring: (const std::array< T, N > &a, const std::array< T, N > &b)
memberdef.name: dot

briefdescription.para: Computes the Euclidean magnitude (L2 norm) of a c-style array.

detaileddescription.para: This function calculates the square root of the sum of squares of all elements in a vector. Internally, it uses SIMD acceleration (via simd_ops) when available. Supports float and double types, enforced by static_assert.

T
The numeric type of the vector elements (float or double only).
data
Pointer to the start of the array.
size
Number of elements in the array.
The Euclidean magnitude of the vector.
Example (float array): #include<iostream> floatdata[]={3.0f,4.0f}; floatresult=magnitude(data,2); std::cout<<"Magnitude:"<<result<<std::endl;//Output:5.0

briefdescription.para: Computes the Euclidean magnitude (L2 norm) of a vector.

detaileddescription.para: This function calculates the square root of the sum of squares of all elements in a vector. Internally, it uses SIMD acceleration (via simd_ops) when available. Supports float and double types, enforced by static_assert.

T
The numeric type of the vector elements (float or double only).
data
Pointer to the start of the array.
size
Number of elements in the array.
The Euclidean magnitude of the vector.
int main() { std::vector<double> vec = {1.0, 2.0, 2.0}; double result = magnitude(vec.data()); std::cout << "Magnitude: " << result << std::endl; // Output: 3.0 return 0; }

briefdescription.para: Computes the squared Euclidean norm of an array.

detaileddescription.para: This internal helper function calculates the sum of squares of all elements in a vector. SIMD acceleration is used via simd_ops<T> if supported. Typically used inside the magnitude() function.

T
The numeric type of the elements (float or double only).
data
Pointer to the input array.
size
Number of elements in the array.
The sum of squared elements (i.e., squared magnitude).
Example: //Calledinternallyby`magnitude()`,typicallynotuseddirectlybyusers. std::array<float,3>v={1.0f,2.0f,2.0f}; floatmag=magnitude(v); std::cout<<"Squaredmagnitude:"<<mag<<std::endl;//Output:9.0

briefdescription.para: Perform standard matrix multiplication (A × B) for dense matrices.

detaileddescription.para: This function multiplies two dense matrices A and B, producing a new matrix C. It supports only float and double data types (enforced via static_assert).
Each element of the resulting matrix is computed as the dot product of a row of A and a column of B. All accessed values must be initialized in A and B.

parameterdescription.para: The numeric type of the matrix (must be float or double)
The left matrix operand (dimensions: m × n)
The right matrix operand (dimensions: n × p)

simplesect.para: Resulting matrix C of dimensions m × p

parameterdescription.para: if the number of columns in A does not match the number of rows in B.

briefdescription.para: Adds a DenseMatrix and a SparseCOOMatrix element-wise.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a new DenseMatrix that represents the element-wise sum of the input dense and sparse matrices. All initialized values in the sparse matrix are added to the corresponding entries in the dense matrix.
The result is fully initialized regardless of which elements were modified by the sparse matrix.

briefdescription.para: Adds a DenseMatrix and a SparseCOOMatrix element-wise.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns a new DenseMatrix that represents the element-wise sum of the input dense and sparse matrices. All initialized values in the sparse matrix are added to the corresponding entries in the dense matrix.
The result is fully initialized regardless of which elements were modified by the sparse matrix.
